name: admin_permission_set
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk permission set — a named grant of workspace-scoped access (scopes and agents) that can be assigned to users via permission set groups.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the permission set.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the permission set is active. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: allowed_workspaces
attributes.description: Workspaces this permission set grants access to. Must contain at least one entry.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace this entry applies to.

attributes.name: allowed_scopes
attributes.description: Scopes within the workspace this permission grants access to. Each entry may be a regex.

attributes.name: denied_scopes
attributes.description: Scopes within the workspace this permission blocks access to. Each entry may be a regex.

attributes.name: allowed_agents
attributes.description: Agents within the workspace this permission grants access to. Each entry may be a regex.

attributes.name: denied_agents
attributes.description: Agents within the workspace this permission blocks access to. Each entry may be a regex.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the permission set was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the permission set was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
